verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a REST API with per-endpoint reference pages and publishes an llms.txt docs index. Neither is a downloadable machine-readable API spec, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any of the standard candidate paths (all returned 404). Missing for 10: a published, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
